source_observation.finding: Dataset admission validates training and transition registry entries against the exact observed mappings, but it retrieves the admitted prototype trace by training_trace.prototype_trace_sha256 and does not prove that this registry key equals SHA-256 of the exact RFC8785/JCS canonical prototype-trace bytes before prototype fields contribute to DatasetAdmission.
source_observation.positive_fixture_signal: The existing dataset admission regression fixture assigns prototype_sha independently as a repeated-hex placeholder-like nonzero digest and stores the prototype mapping under that key; the positive admission test succeeds without deriving that key from the prototype mapping bytes.
source_observation.producer_identity_law: Global J-Space prototype JSpaceStep.trace_sha256 is defined from SHA-256 over canonicalized trace bytes, so the dataset boundary can and should verify the same content identity rather than treating an arbitrary external registry alias as equivalent evidence identity.

hypothesis: An admitted_prototype_traces registry alias can currently satisfy prototype admission even when its key is not the canonical content digest of the prototype trace, weakening exact causal provenance at the training-dataset boundary.
counterhypothesis: The external registry producer may guarantee key/content identity upstream, making a second check redundant.
counterhypothesis_adjudication: The current admission function contract does not receive or verify such an upstream guarantee, and its own positive fixture demonstrates that arbitrary key/content association is accepted at this boundary. Therefore exact key/content verification is a useful local fail-closed invariant rather than a second authority.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator: derive the positive fixture prototype_sha from SHA-256 of exact RFC8785/JCS canonical prototype bytes
add a hard negative where unchanged prototype bytes are registered under an alias key and require PROTOTYPE_TRACE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH

minimal_repair: canonicalize dict(prototype_trace) with the already-selected Entry RFC8785/JCS authority
compute SHA-256 over those canonical bytes
require the digest to equal training_trace.prototype_trace_sha256 before prototype fields can contribute to DatasetAdmission
preserve the same admitted_prototype_traces registry and avoid introducing any second truth/state authority
